class.name: MaszynaE3DModelGeometry
class.brief_description: The geometry of a model file, apart from its description.
class.description: What of a model file ([code].e3d[/code], [code].t3d[/code]) goes to the GPU: the arrays of every submodel of triangles, by its [member MaszynaE3DSubModel.geometry_index]. It is data only, in memory while a model is read and its cache written or read, and let go once the model's meshes are made of it ([method MaszynaE3DModel.apply_geometry]) - an [ArrayMesh] keeps nothing of it but in the GPU. Written from the parse's arrays, so writing it reads nothing back from the GPU.

method.name: mesh_create
method.description: Returns the mesh of the surface [param index], made in the [RenderingServer] - the GPU; null for a submodel without triangles.

members.member: One surface a submodel, by its geometry index; empty for one without triangles. Keys: [code]vertices[/code], [code]normals[/code], [code]tangents[/code] (optional), [code]uvs[/code] ([PackedFloat32Array]), [code]indices[/code] ([PackedInt32Array], the triangles clockwise).

constants.constant: Version of what the parsers put into the geometry; raised to invalidate its cache.
